title: GF(2^m) batch mul/square m=8,16,32 via VPCLMULQDQ
description:
Add an AVX2 batch element-wise multiply/square kernel for GF($2^m$) at $m \in \{8, 16, 32\}$. Per-element scalar dispatch leaves throughput on the table when VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM can process two element pairs per instruction.

## Background

`Gf2mField::mul` and `square` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/field.rs` are called per-element. No batch element-wise SIMD path exists for $m \leq 32$ even though VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM can process two element pairs per instruction and the reduction lookup table fits in a single YMM lane for $m \leq 32$.

The fix adds a new `Gf2mBatchFns` set in `gf2-kernels-simd` (sibling of the existing `Gf2mFns`) and a `simd::maybe_gf2m_batch()` accessor:

- V3 SIMD: VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM (2 element pairs per instruction) plus Barrett reduce in YMM.
- V4 unroll: 4-way unroll across the dependent reduce step for ILP.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. all existing scalar strategies for $m \in \{8, 16, 32\}$.
- [hard] Existing `gf2m_mul_strategies.rs` shows the new batch path on its strategy comparison table.
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact regenerated and shows VPCLMULQDQ + Barrett reduce mnemonics.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean over the fastest existing strategy for batches $\geq 256$ elements.

## Notes

Bench: `gf2m_mul_strategies` (existing, pinned by I1). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
